_comment: Master events maintained by the intelligence desk (see docs/INTELLIGENCE-ENGINE.md). One entry per real-world event; reports from several sources are clustered into it.

HM-2026-111201.title: IMO Urges Hormuz Rule Enforcement

sources.title: IMO Chief Calls for Strict Enforcement of SOLAS Rules in Strait of Hormuz
IMO Chief Calls For Enforcement Of Maritime Rules In Strait Of Hormuz After 25 Seafarers Die In 133 Incidents
IMO Calls for All Parties in Hormuz Crisis to Respect Seafarer Safety

verifiedFacts: IMO SG statement 11 Nov 2026 urging flag, port and coastal states to enforce rules
133 confirmed incidents involving merchant vessels as of 10 Nov
At least 25 seafarers killed since 28 Feb
Cited substandard ships, concealed IMO numbers, fraudulent registration and false flags

HM-2026-111202.title: Maersk Boxship Topples Crane at Yantian

sources.title: Crane overturned
Containership Maersk Cincinnati Knocks Down Crane While Berthing at Yantian
15,516 TEU Container Ship Hits And Topples Ship-To-Shore Crane At Yantian Port In China

verifiedFacts: Maersk Cincinnati, 15,516 TEU, Singapore flag, built 2024
Struck STS crane while berthing at Yantian on 9 Nov 2026
Crane toppled onto stacked containers
No injuries reported
Yantian District Emergency Management Bureau investigating
unverifiedClaims: Wind gusts as cause (reported, not confirmed)

HM-2026-111203.title: Three Robberies Hit Singapore Strait

sources.title: ReCAAP warns of further Singapore Strait robberies after three November boardings
One Of The World's Busiest Shipping Lanes Sees Three Robberies In Eight Days
Two incidents of armed robbery against ships in Asia Nov 3-9: ReCAAP

verifiedFacts: Star Calypso boarded 2 Nov 21:25, engine spares stolen, crew member tied up with minor injury
APJ Priti 2 boarded 4 Nov 23:35, nothing stolen
Tanker boarded 10 Nov 02:40, engine spares stolen
All in eastbound lane of Singapore Strait TSS
unverifiedClaims: Name and flag of the tanker boarded on 10 Nov

Panama Canal Raises Daily Transits To 34 And Restores 50-Foot Neopanamax Draft As Water Levels Recover

Shipping giant Maersk probes IT security incident, data theft
Maersk investigates data breach involving legacy IT system

HM-2026-111206.title: AMSA Bans Bulker Over False Rest Hours

AMSA bans vessel over repeatedly falsifying seafarer hours of work and rest records
AMSA bans bulk carrier over repeated falsification of seafarer work and rest records

Falsified work and rest records
90-day ban under section 246 Navigation Act 2012
Third detention for hours records (Dec 2023, Aug 2026)

HM-2026-111207.title: Projectiles Hit Tankers Around Hormuz

sources.title: Tanker Ablaze Off UAE as More Attacks Rattle Gulf Shipping
Three Tankers Attacked in Two Days in Strait of Hormuz Crisis
All Crew Safe After Tanker Struck off UAE Coast
Sinokor-linked VLCCs attacked: four injured in first attack, second sees tanker evacuated off UAE
All 19 Indian Seafarers Safe After Oil Tanker Hit By Projectile Off UAE Port

verifiedFacts: Dominica Prosperity, Liberia-flag crude tanker, struck in engine room by unidentified projectile ~1800 UTC 11 Nov 2026, ~14 nm NW of Ras Al Khaimah (UKMTO)
All 22 crew (19 Indian) evacuated by UAE Coast Guard, no injuries (UAE CG / India shipping minister)
Fire; firefighting ongoing when UKMTO warning issued 12 Nov
NCC Fajr struck ~0200 UTC 11 Nov north of Khasab, Oman; crew safe (JMIC 12 Nov advisory, Omani authorities)
Fujairah Energy struck 10 Nov eastbound in Arabian Gulf; crew injured and taken ashore (JMIC)
Unidentified tanker struck 10 Nov ~19 nm NE of Lima, Oman; crew safe, no pollution reported (JMIC)
JMIC counts 181 maritime security incidents since 1 March
Dominica Prosperity: 297,274 dwt, operator Sinokor, manager Anglo-Eastern (Equasis via Riviera); Ambrey: hit on stern, no injuries or pollution reported
unverifiedClaims: Attribution of the individual strikes (JMIC has not identified perpetrators)
Operator of Dominica Prosperity (Sinokor per MARISKS via Reuters)
Pollution / extent of damage on Dominica Prosperity
IRGC navy claim (13 Nov) that an LNG tanker struck a naval mine and exploded in Hormuz
conflicts: Fujairah Energy injured count: '4 injured' (MarEx citing India) vs 'multiple' (JMIC)
HM-2026-111207.notes: Not breaking (<90, no fatalities). Candidate for the 13 Nov 08:22 slot if a free-licence photo is found and an update (damage/pollution) emerges; related to published HM-2026-111201. 13 Nov 07:20: no materially new verified information found this run; not carded (bridge-strike incident chosen for 08:22 as fresher). 13 Nov 13:10: IRGC claim of an LNG tanker mine explosion in Hormuz (Reuters via Hellenic Shipping News) is unverified, single-party claim; not carded. 13 Nov 19:05: carded for 20:22 slot (score 75, recency reduced to 14 as events are 2-3 days old); IRGC LNG mine claim still unconfirmed by UKMTO/JMIC (gCaptain/Reuters 13 Nov: no vessel details) and excluded.

HM-2026-111301.title: Bulk Carrier Strikes Delaware River Bridge

sources.title: Cargo ship strikes bridge between New Jersey and Philadelphia, causing traffic backup
Singapore-flagged cargo ship strikes US bridge

verifiedFacts: Strategic Alliance (Singapore flag, 180 m / 591 ft, built 2013, handysize bulk carrier) struck the Tacony-Palmyra Bridge ~13:15 local 12 Nov 2026 (USCG via AP; Splash247)
Drawbridge was open for ship passage at the time (AP)
No injuries reported (AP)
Ship moored at Kinder Morgan facility, Bristol PA; USCG inspection team on site (USCG via AP)
Bridge reopened Thursday evening with a lane closure (Burlington County Bridge Commission Police via AP)
unverifiedClaims: Extent of bridge damage (state Rep. Neilson said span was 'unable to close')
HM-2026-111301.notes: Queued for 13 Nov 08:22 slot. Representative PD photo (US Navy 1944, cargo ship under bridge); the Commons photo of a bulk carrier at this bridge (File:Bufflehead-Tacony-MT.jpg) was not used because its licence could not be checked this run. UPDATE card only if NTSB/USCG findings or significant damage details emerge.

HM-2026-111302.title: 14 Crew Rescued as Cargo Ship Sinks

sources.title: 14 rescued after cargo ship sinks off east China coast
14 Seafarers Rescued After Chinese Bulk Carrier Sinks In Yellow Sea

verifiedFacts: Steel-laden Chinese cargo ship sank ~20 nm NE of Binhai Port, Yancheng, Jiangsu, morning of Mon 9 Nov 2026 (Bastille Post citing Donghai Rescue Bureau; Marine Insight)
High winds and heavy waves flooded two starboard compartments; severe list, distress signal, then sinking during a severe cold wave (Bastille Post)
Eight crew went into the water (Bastille Post)
Donghai Rescue Bureau sent a rescue vessel and two helicopters; gale-force winds, 4 m waves (Bastille Post)
All 14 crew rescued (Bastille Post; Marine Insight)
unverifiedClaims: Vessel name and ship type (Marine Insight: Chinese-flagged bulk carrier; Bastille Post: cargo ship)
HM-2026-111302.notes: Queued for 13 Nov 14:22 slot. Representative PD USCG rescue photo (Commons pages could not be opened this run; licence follows from USCG authorship, VIRIN G-). UPDATE only with investigation findings or vessel identity plus material new facts.
